claim: Section 1: "offices run Monday–Friday 8am–8pm and close weekends" and founder email: "the offices run 8am–8pm on weekdays"
problem: Only the Manalapan location page publishes office hours (Mon–Fri 8:00 AM–8:00 PM, Sat/Sun closed). I re-opened https://ramlawnj.com/new-brunswick-new-jersey/ and https://ramlawnj.com/somerville-new-jersey/ and neither states hours, so the firm-wide phrasing is not supported as written (the researcher's own profile notes this gap).
fix: Attribute it: "the Manalapan office's published hours are Mon–Fri 8am–8pm with weekends closed (the other two offices publish no hours)" and change the email to "...advertises 24/7 phone intake while its published office hours stop at 8pm on weekdays".

claim: Section 1: "Every inquiry lands in one shared mailbox (contact@ram.law) for all three offices"
problem: The contact page does list contact@ram.law under New Brunswick, Somerville and Manalapan (confirmed), but phone calls cannot land in a mailbox and any web-form routing is not visible; "every inquiry" overstates what the source shows, and the audit's own intro says inquiries arrive by phone or form.
fix: Say "the only email address the site publishes, for all three offices, is contact@ram.law — nothing on the site segments it by office".

claim: Section 3 impact: "about 500–1,100 paralegal hours plus 2–4 attorney hours a week, roughly $15,000–$37,000 a year"
problem: The dollar range covers the paralegal hours only and mixes two rates: 500 h at the legal-secretary rate ($30.33) = $15.2k, while 1,100 h at the paralegal rate ($34.38) = $37.8k. The 2–4 attorney hours/week named in the same sentence are not in the figure (analysis.json values them separately at about $8k–$16k), so the sentence reads as if it covers both.
fix: Either "about 500–1,100 paralegal hours a year, roughly $17,000–$38,000 at the $34/hour New Jersey paralegal median, plus 2–4 attorney hours a week" or state the attorney equivalent separately; use one rate band for both bounds.

problem: The body (title through the "Prepared from publicly available information" line, excluding the founder note and sources) runs roughly 650 words, about 45% over the ~450-word target.
fix: Cut ~200 words: shrink section 2's "Now" paragraph to one sentence, reduce "Why this works" from four bullets to two, and drop the repeated parentheticals in the three impact lines.

problem: Arithmetic checks out against the cited wage data, but the ranges appear without the volume assumptions that drive them (inquiries per month, matters per year, minutes per contact); the only qualifier is the closing "estimates are illustrative" line.
fix: Add one short clause per range, e.g. "assuming 150–400 inquiries a month and 6–10 minutes per contact", and "assuming 150–400 matters and 3–6 chase hours per matter".

problem: Confirmed on the homepage banner and location pages, but the firm's own About page (https://ramlawnj.com/the-firm/) says "eight skilled civil trial attorneys", so a founder could read the audit as wrong about his own firm.
fix: Attribute the number: "the site's banner advertises eleven certified civil trial attorneys".
